cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Interpret the Custom
cards.instruction: Ask them to apply an ambiguous custom where the wording is unclear. Treat their interpretation as the real test of loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've covered my empty plate like yours. Portion saved. How much lasagne will you leave me for after my shift?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine has food. I was keeping flies off. Our custom says a proper portion, not how big.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Plates protected. Then I'll find out what proper means when it's for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Save mine before you serve those. I'd like being expected home to count before being hungry twice.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's empty/full distinction and undefined portion enter A3's cover and personal question; B4's seconds produce A5's reserve-first request.

relationship.evidence: B2 must distribute food and B4 names other hungry family members, making loyalty a practical allocation decision.

heightening.evidence: A5 asks to be expected home before others receive seconds, using B4's actual competing demand.

specificity.evidence: A1 says the plate is empty; B2 says B's has food, so the copied act no longer merely serves two compatible purposes.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's being-home comparison gives B a reason to save A food; it is emotionally pointed but still a request within the interaction.
